descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We’re looking for an experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to join a team working on scalable, secure, and high-performance applications.
 Your responsibilities 
Develop and maintain enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend technologies.
Build robust backend services, implement business logic, and integrate REST APIs.
Create responsive and intuitive user interfaces using Angular or other JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
Design, query, and optimize relational databases.
Contribute to software architecture, technical design, and code reviews.
Implement automated tests and maintain high standards of code quality.
Work with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-based environments.
Apply security best practices and help ensure application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
 What you bring 
A university degree meeting the applicable qualification requirements and 10–12+ years of professional IT experience, depending on the degree level.
At least 7 years of software development experience.
5+ years of recent hands-on experience with Java and Spring/Spring Boot.
5+ years of recent experience with relational databases and SQL.
2+ years of recent experience with Angular or a comparable modern frontend framework.
At least 2 years of recent, hands-on full-stack development experience.
Practical experience with REST APIs, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud/container deployments.
Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, JPA/Hibernate, and Git.
Familiarity with API security, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, and OWASP security principles.
Experience with automated testing and Agile development practices.
English proficiency at C1 level or above.
 It’s a plus if you have 
Experience with AWS or Azure.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices.
Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, monitoring, logging, and tracing.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools.
Relevant technical certifications or knowledge of French.
